description: Threadlike organic filaments lace across nearly an astronomical unit of space, knotted into bulbous node-clusters that glow with dim violet light. Long-range sensors return layered organic signatures threaded with electromagnetic rhythms indistinguishable from a dreaming brain. The whole network reads less like a colony and more like a single thought under construction.

The Meridian expands in surges every nineteen days, flinging spore-seeds ahead of its advancing threads. Vessels passing nearby hear a low choral pulse on open channels, and crews report matching headaches in perfect synchrony. Contact brings bonding: hair-fine hyphae grip hulls and taste their systems.

The freighter Amaranth Vow spent eleven days entangled before cutting free; her crew disembarked finishing one another's sentences and mostly recovered within a year. Xeno-biologists classify the network as a distributed hive intelligence in early adolescence. Its neurons fire in patterns that map disturbingly well onto commercial trade logic.

Traffic lanes bend around the Meridian by common consent, though research barges hold station at its edge year-round. The expansion surges are getting longer, and its outer threads recently brushed an inhabited system's cometary halo. Negotiating with a mind the size of a star system has officially entered the diplomatic agenda.
